Title: Serverless pricing model for Azure Cosmos DB

Body.Content:
Azure Cosmos DB will introduce a new serverless pricing model in the coming months.

Serverless will handle traffic bursts on demand, making it easy to run spiky workloads without any resource planning or management needed. This model is ideal for applications that don’t have sustained traffic, and charges are based only on storage and database operations performed.

Read the announcement blog.
